name: Tablet conservator
design: Tall narrow-built male with elongated brushed bronze mask, central raised forehead ridge and two short jaw seams, very long scalp tendrils bound low. Full moss leather working apron over solid sage sleeves and dark trousers, silver segmented elbow guards and short green cape. Left hand holds a single CLOSED rigid record tablet, right holds a blunt restoration brush with protective cap, several tiny sealed preservative containers and a rounded tool satchel on hips.
